description: This file defines a Dropzone class for handling drag-and-drop image uploads and file insertion within a rich text editor, specifically for the Summernote editor. It manages event attachment, visual feedback, and file processing.

classes.name: Dropzone
classes.description: A class managing drag-and-drop file upload and insertion in the Summernote editor.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Dropzone instance with context, sets up DOM elements and options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Attaches drag-and-drop event handlers based on configuration.

methods.name: attachDragAndDropEvent
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for dragenter, dragleave, drop, and related interactions for the dropzone.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes all event handlers attached by this Dropzone instance.
